title: Reorganize plugin-object docs into subdirectory structure with component-specific pages
body:
The plugin-object documentation was a single monolithic file. Restructured into subdirectory with dedicated pages for each component (ObjectTable, ObjectForm, ObjectView) for better discoverability and navigation.

## Structure Changes

- **Created** `/content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/` subdirectory
- **Split** monolithic `plugin-object.mdx` into:
  - `index.mdx` - Plugin overview with component links
  - `object-table.mdx` - ObjectTable component reference
  - `object-form.mdx` - ObjectForm component reference (create/edit modes)
  - `object-view.mdx` - ObjectView component reference (list/detail/edit views)
  - `meta.json` - Navigation metadata

## Content Organization

Each component page includes:
- Interactive demos
- Usage examples (React + JSON schema)
- Property reference tables
- Advanced configuration patterns
- Cross-component navigation links

Navigation now follows same pattern as `/content/docs/components/` subdirectories (basic, form, layout, etc.)
